answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using TPM remote attestation. Each agent generates a key inside a Trusted Platform Module, an isolated hardware haven that proves possession of a vendor-certified endorsement key to sign a fresh nonce per chip. Attackers incur the capital cost of dedicated silicon and copper hardware per identity instead of cheap software clones. However, vendor root authorities form a velvet rope that excludes uncertified devices and centralizes admission.
